Pretext 0.0.9 (MIT), copied from the locked `@chenglou/pretext` package's
published `dist/` files. These seven ESM files are the import closure of
`layout.js`; the Recorder serves them locally from its static Tauri `web/`
directory. The package version is pinned in `package.json` and `pnpm-lock.yaml`.
Upstream: https://github.com/chenglou/pretext
